# Atraium 0.3.4 Preview 7

Atraium 0.3.4 Preview 7 improves access to generated files, image-generation feedback, and conversation reliability. It is a usability and reliability update for [Preview 6](https://github.com/daemosofchaos/Atraium-Preview/releases/tag/v0.3.4-preview.6).

## What changed

### Generated files are easier to find

- Generated documents now appear in their own **Generated files** section above Reasoning and Activity, rather than at the bottom of the Activity panel.
- The section is expanded by default, with filenames and download actions immediately accessible. It can be collapsed independently.
- Generated files remain accessible even when a response contains no accompanying text, and are no longer duplicated inside Activity.

### Clearer image-generation feedback

- Image-generation and image-editing placeholders now match the requested number of images instead of always showing three.
- Loading placeholders appear even before the assistant writes a response and are cleared when the operation finishes or fails.

### On-demand context and reliability improvements

- Current time, platform, Workspace, and file-access information are now available to assistants through an on-demand **Turn Context** tool instead of being automatically added to every message.
- Turn Context is directly available by default. Room and Workspace settings can still disable it or change its access method.
- Hardened folder-access requests to reduce the risk of instability when access settings change.
- Improved handling of automatic context continuation, including intentional interruptions and the conversation state used for the next request.

## Platforms

- **Windows desktop:** recommended preview experience.
- **Android:** early sideloaded preview for Android 7.0 or later, supporting arm64-v8a devices and x86_64 emulators.
- **Web, macOS, and iOS:** not included in this preview.

## Important notes

- This is preview software and may contain breaking issues.
- The previous current-turn context injection setting has been removed. Use Room or Workspace tool settings to control access to Turn Context.
- Context continuation has been hardened, but intermittent failures remain under observation. Please report reproducible cases.
- Support is best-effort.

## Costs and credentials

Atraium does not include provider credentials, model credits, local-server software, or token allowances. You are responsible for usage, hardware, and charges from the providers and services you configure. Set provider-side limits and review [Token usage and provider billing](https://github.com/daemosofchaos/Atraium-Preview/blob/main/TOKEN-USAGE-AND-BILLING.md) before using paid credentials.
